instructions: How to use: Sort by Renewal Window Start, then focus top 6 accounts with Dynamic Probability between 30-70 for active plays.
Engagement Score calc: (last 90-day active touchpoints * 0.6) + (product usage percentile * 0.4), normalized to 0-100.
Dynamic Probability rule-of-thumb: base probability from contract health + (engagement score - 50) * 0.6, clamp 10-95%.
Play selection guidance: use Suggested Play options (exec pack, pilot extension, dedicated trial, procurement checklist) based on Primary Risk Driver.
calc_notes: Row examples include padded ARR formatting; ARR passed as integer but sheet displays with commas.
Dynamic Probability shown is illustrative — CSM should recalc using live engagement signals before QBR.
Do not use the Dynamic Probability as sole source of truth for legal/finance negotiations.
